हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A rational, wealthy couple dismisses the supernatural—until their daughter Tia falls under a terrifying, unexplained force. As her life fades, her grandfather calls Vishwa, a healer who warns they have one hour. But her parents stop and humiliate him, wasting precious time. As Tia slips closer to death, Vishwa must fight against all odds to save her—while her parents face the tragic cost of their disbelief.
